title: Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Billing Limits: Lookback, Agent Adjustment and Rounding
content:
Three billing limits apply across Commercial Natural Gas Supply: the number of calendar months after posting during which a bill line may be corrected, the largest rebill credit a care agent may post on one line, and the rounding applied to every computed charge.

| Plan | Correction lookback after posting (calendar months) | Largest rebill credit a care agent may post on one line (USD) | Rounding of every computed charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | 12 | 250.00 | Half up to the cent |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed Basis 12 | 12 | 250.00 | Half up to the cent |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 | 12 | 250.00 | Half up to the cent |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 | 12 | 250.00 | Half up to the cent |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 | 12 | 250.00 | Half up to the cent |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 | 12 | 250.00 | Half up to the cent |

## Notes

- The limits do not vary by plan: the lookback is 12 calendar months and the agent adjustment limit is $250.00 per line on all six plans.
- Half up to the cent means a computed amount is carried to two decimal places, a third decimal of 5 or more raising the cent. A hypothetical computed charge of $41.235 is billed as $41.24 and one of $41.234 as $41.23.
- The agent adjustment limit is a per-line amount. A correction on one line larger than $250.00 is outside what a care agent may post on that line.
